answer: Votes are weighted after a distributional audit. Each answer is fingerprinted on perplexity, burstiness and syntax depth, and identities whose submissions cluster tightly are merged into one weight, however many wallets they hold. Paraphrasing fails: rewording keeps the generation signature, so a velvet layer of fresh prose still lands in the same cluster. Separate weight requires genuinely different reasoning, a full atlas of distinct model behaviours per identity. Attacker cost: N inference bills and N separately graded answers, with no pearl to reuse — one cloned answer buys one vote.
